simple.meaning: מִלָּה (millâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a word , command , discourse , or subject.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 24 times across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 2:5. Its contexts include Torah, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִלָּה (H4406).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

timeline.evidenceText: The king answered the Chaldeans, “The thing has gone from me. If you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut in pieces, and your houses will be made a dunghill.
The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.

But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation.”

The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler, has asked such a thing of any magician, or enchanter, or Chaldean.

The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler, has asked such a thing of any magician, or enchanter, or Chaldean.
It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.”
He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
I thank you, and praise you,
Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceedingly hot, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.

Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, “Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent his angel, and delivered his servants who trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and have yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.
All this came on the king Nebuchadnezzar.
The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?”

The queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house. The queen spoke and said, “O king, live forever; don’t let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.
Now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me its interpretation; but they could not show the interpretation of the thing.
“This is the interpretation of the thing:

Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t respect you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.”
Then these men assembled together to the king, and said to the king, “Know, O king, that it is a law of the Medes and Persians, that no decree nor statute which the king establishes may be changed.”
In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head on his bed. Then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.
“I watched at that time because of the voice of the great words which the horn spoke. I watched even until the animal was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.

definitions.short: a word , command , discourse , or subject
definitions.full: H4406. millah מִלָּה noun feminine word, thing ; — absolute ׳מ Dan 2:9 +, construct מִלַּת 2:10 +; emphatic 2:5 +, ָ א , 2:8 +; plural absolute מִלּין 7:1 , 25 , construct מִלֵּי 5:10 , emphatic מִלַּיָּא 7:11 , 16 ; — 1 word, utterance Dan 4:28 ; 6:15 , plural 5:10 ; 7:11 , 25 ; in bad sense, ׳מ וּשְׁחִיתָה כִדְבָח 2:9 , רַבְרְבָתָא מִלַּיָּא 7:11 (compare רַבְרְבָן alone 7:8 ; 7:20 ); word of God's judgment 4:30 ; = command 2:5 , 8 ; 3:22 , 28 ; 6:13 . 2 thing, affair, matter: Dan 2:10 (twice in verse); 2:11 , 15 , 17 , 23 ; 5:15 , 26 ; 7:28 (twice in verse), plural 7:1 ; 7:16 .
